Dataset: questions tagged 'etl', creation date > 2021-01-01

sql.query:
with questions as (
    select
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), DAY) AS `date`,
        count(*) as num_questions
    from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_questions`
    group by `date`
),
answers as (
    select
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), DAY) AS `date`,
        count(*) as num_answers
    from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_answers`
    group by `date`
),
askers as (
    select
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), DAY) AS `date`,
        count(distinct(owner_user_id)) as num_askers
    from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_questions`
    group by `date`
),
answerers as (
    select
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), DAY) AS `date`,
        count(distinct(owner_user_id)) as num_answerers
    from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_answers`
    group by `date`
)

select
    questions.date as `date`,
    questions.num_questions,
    answers.num_answers,
    askers.num_askers,
    answerers.num_answerers
from questions
left join answers on answers.date = questions.date
left join askers on askers.date = questions.date
left join answerers on answerers.date = questions.date
order by `date` desc

sql.query:
select
    id,
    owner_user_id,
    (
        select count(*)
        from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_votes`
        where post_id = filtered_answers.id
        and vote_type_id = 2
    ) as upvote_count,
    (
        select count(*)
        from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_votes`
        where post_id = filtered_answers.id
        and vote_type_id = 3
    ) as downvote_count
from `sdg-team-bankin-dataplex-demo`.`Artefacto_Linaje`.`filtered_answers`
